Text.Text: I'm Ranger Tam Orrel, from Czerka wildlife control. Czerka owns the land rights out there, but the wildlife has not read the contract. I pay people to help me keep it in check.
Thank you. Czerka pays a bounty for every bird, and I checked the contract twice to be sure. Here is your pay for all ten.
You are back, and my survey team came home with all of its poles for the first time. Did you kill all ten Warocas?

Warocas are the nearest problem. They are big, flightless, bad tempered birds, and they charge anyone carrying a survey pole. I need you to kill ten Warocas, either in the Wildlands or by the Lake. Come back to me when it is done and Czerka will pay you a bounty.
Good. Kill ten Warocas in the Wildlands or by the Lake on Viscara, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Warocas in the Wildlands or by the Lake on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
Thank you, and I mean that. The trails are safe to walk again. Here is your pay, as the contract says.
You are back, and I walked the east trail this morning without watching the branches. Did you kill all ten Kinrath?

Kinrath have strung webs across every trail in the Wildwoods, and they hang above them waiting for something to walk in. I lost a pack animal that way last week. I need you to kill ten Kinrath in the Wildwoods. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill ten Kinrath in the Wildwoods on Viscara, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Kinrath in the Wildwoods on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
Good work. I am adding a hazard rate on top of the bounty, although Czerka does not know I authorized it. Here is your pay.
You are back, and there are fewer tracks at the waterholes now. Did you kill all eight Gimpassa Hatchlings?

There are Gimpassa. They are only hatchlings, but a hatchling is the size of a speeder and can bite through one. The Wildwoods are filling up with them. I need you to kill eight Gimpassa Hatchlings in the Wildwoods before they finish growing. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill eight Gimpassa Hatchlings in the Wildwoods on Viscara, then come back to me here.
They live somewhere deeper in the wilds, and I do not go there. You will only find hatchlings in the Wildwoods, and I am grateful for that.
You still need to kill eight Gimpassa Hatchlings in the Wildwoods on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
Thank you. The Talyrons sent a cheese to say the same. I am keeping the cheese, but the bounty is all yours.
You are back, and the herders are moving their stock through the valley again. Did you kill all eight Nashtah?

Nashtah are. They have six legs and three rows of teeth, and they will follow a herder for a whole day before they attack. The Talyron family has already lost two farmhands to them. I need you to kill eight Nashtah in the Mountain Valley. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill eight Nashtah in the Mountain Valley on Viscara, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill eight Nashtah in the Mountain Valley on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
Then Czerka has a mine it can open. I made sure the company remembered to pay you for it. Here is your bounty.
You are back, and a mining crew went into the Cavern yesterday and complained only about the damp. Did you kill all eight Crystal Spiders?

It would like to. There is a Cavern full of crystal, but it is also full of the Crystal Spiders that grow it, and the miners refuse to go inside. I need you to kill eight Crystal Spiders in the Cavern. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill eight Crystal Spiders in the Cavern on Viscara, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill eight Crystal Spiders in the Cavern on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
That is the best news I have had this season. Here is my top rate. I am filing it as predator control, because nobody at Czerka reads past the heading.
You are back, and there have been no raid fires on the swamp side for four nights. Did you kill all twelve Vellen Flesheaters?

The Vellen Flesheaters are the worst of it. They are not wildlife, whatever my contract calls them. They took the old Coxxion Base and they raid out of the Swamplands at night. I need you to kill twelve Vellen Flesheaters, either at the Coxxion Base or in the Swamplands. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay my top rate.
Good. Kill twelve Vellen Flesheaters at the Coxxion Base or in the Swamplands on Viscara, then come back to me here.
They want exactly what their name says. They raid the colony's outskirts for people to eat, so whatever happens out there, do not let them take you alive.
You still need to kill twelve Vellen Flesheaters at the Coxxion Base or in the Swamplands on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
Good work. Here is your patrol rate. The Wildlands will need another patrol soon, so take the job again whenever you like.
You are back, and you smell like Kath Hound. Did you finish the patrol and kill ten Warocas and ten Kath Hounds?

I do, every week. The Wildlands only stay quiet for a few days at a time. A patrol means killing ten Warocas and ten Kath Hounds in the Wildlands. Each time you finish one, come back to me and I will pay you a patrol rate. You can take it as often as you like.
Good. Kill ten Warocas and ten Kath Hounds in the Wildlands on Viscara, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Warocas and ten Kath Hounds in the Wildlands on Viscara. Come back to me when it is done.
Watch the treeline, Ranger. Goodbye.
What other wildlife is giving you trouble?
Yes, all ten Warocas are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill ten Warocas.
Not right now. I will leave the birds alone.
What is attacking your survey teams near the colony?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Warocas.
Yes, all ten Kinrath are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill ten Kinrath.
Not right now. I do not like spiders.
What is the problem on the trails in the Wildwoods?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Kinrath.
Yes, all eight Gimpassa Hatchlings are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill eight Gimpassa Hatchlings.
Not right now. Those are too big for me.
Where are the adult Gimpassa?
Is there anything bigger than Kinrath in the Wildwoods?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Gimpassa Hatchlings.
Yes, all eight Nashtah are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill eight Nashtah.
Not right now. I will stay in the lowlands.
What is hunting the herders in the mountains?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Nashtah.
Yes, all eight Crystal Spiders are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill eight Crystal Spiders.
Not right now. I do not want to go underground.
Does Czerka do any mining out here?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Crystal Spiders.
Yes, all twelve Vellen Flesheaters are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill twelve Vellen Flesheaters.
Not right now. That is a job for soldiers.
What do the Vellen Flesheaters want?
What is the most dangerous thing you deal with?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Vellen Flesheaters.
Yes, I killed ten Warocas and ten Kath Hounds.
I will come back.
On my way.
Sign me up. Ten Warocas and ten Kath Hounds.
Not this week. Maybe another time.
Do you have any steady patrol work?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the Wildlands patrol involves.
